escenas.prompt: Static camera. Golden early-morning sunlight on a quiet Florida street in front of a sand-colored stucco house. The three pop-up lawn sprinklers in the grass strip by the curb spray steady sparkling fans of water that gently sway side to side, droplets glittering in the sun. Palm leaves sway softly. No people, no animals, no cars. The house does not change. No camera movement.

Static camera. Golden early-morning light. The woman in the pink t-shirt walks slowly forward along the edge of the street toward the right with her small white fluffy dog trotting on a red leash beside her. The three sprinklers keep spraying sparkling fans of water just ahead of her. Her mouth does not move. Only one person and one small dog. No camera movement.

escenas.prompt: The exterior camera under the eave detects movement.

Static camera. Golden early-morning light. The three sprinklers in the grass strip by the curb stop: their fans of water quickly shrink, drop down and disappear, and the sprinkler heads stay still and quiet. The woman with the small white dog stands at the left, looks at the sprinklers and smiles. Only one person and one small dog. The house does not change. No camera movement.

Static camera. Golden early-morning light. The woman in the pink t-shirt walks calmly to the right past the front of the house along the wet street edge with her small white fluffy dog trotting on the red leash. The sprinklers stay off. She smiles, relaxed. Her mouth does not move. Only one person and one small dog. No camera movement.

escenas.prompt: Static camera. Golden early-morning light at an outdoor plant nursery. The man in the olive green shirt stands still by the open tailgate of the black pickup, holding his phone low; he glances down at it, nods softly and smiles a little. The phone screen is never visible. His mouth does not move, he does not speak. Palm leaves sway gently. Nobody else around. No camera movement.

Static camera. Golden early-morning light on the empty street in front of the house. The three pop-up sprinklers in the grass strip by the curb turn back on: water starts spraying up into sparkling fans that grow steadily. Palm leaves sway softly. No people, no animals, no cars. The house does not change. No camera movement.

partes.texto: ¿Por qué se apagó el riego de repente?
Una vecina sale con su perrito.
Y el riego se detiene solo.
Daniel cuida jardines ajenos. El suyo, la casa.
Cuando ella pasa, vuelve a regar.
Geo Homes. Tu casa, a tu ritmo.
